description: This file declares the interface for managing RT message connections, including creation, destruction, message sending (both text and binary), request-response handling, and listener management within an RPC or messaging framework.

methods.name: rtConnection_Create
methods.description: Creates a new RT connection with specified application name and router configuration or configuration message.

methods.name: rtConnection_Destroy
methods.description: Destroys an existing RT connection, freeing associated resources.

methods.name: rtConnection_SendMessage
methods.description: Sends a text message on a specified topic through the connection.

methods.name: rtConnection_SendMessageDirect
methods.description: Sends a text message to a specific listener on a given topic.

methods.name: rtConnection_SendRequest
methods.description: Performs a request-response cycle with a specified timeout.

methods.name: rtConnection_SendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response to a received request.

methods.name: rtConnection_SendBinary
methods.description: Sends a binary payload message on a specified topic.

methods.name: rtConnection_SendBinaryDirect
methods.description: Sends a binary message directly to a specific listener.

methods.name: rtConnection_SendBinaryResponse
methods.description: Sends a binary response to a request.

methods.name: rtConnection_AddListener
methods.description: Registers a callback to listen for messages matching an expression.

methods.name: rtConnection_RemoveListener
methods.description: Removes a message listener for a specific expression.

methods.name: rtConnection_AddAlias
methods.description: Adds an alias to an existing listener.

methods.name: rtConnection_RemoveAlias
methods.description: Removes an alias from an existing listener.

methods.name: rtConnection_AddDefaultListener
methods.description: Registers a default callback for all incoming messages.

methods.name: rtConnection_GetReturnAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the return address associated with the connection.

methods.name: rtConnection_Dispatch
methods.description: Processes incoming messages; note mentions it may be a placeholder and needs updating.

ctags.name: rtMessageCallback
ctags.pattern: /^typedef void (*rtMessageCallback)(rtMessageHeader const* hdr, uint8_t const* buff, uint32_t n, v/
ctags.typeref: typename:void (*)(rtMessageHeader const * hdr,uint8_t const * buff,uint32_t n,void * closure)
